verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents its own agent capabilities that a user can hand tasks to. An MCP client "can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer," which browses, runs code and creates documents. The Agent API also offers presets that give "a working agent in one field" with Perplexity-hosted tools. However, delegation happens programmatically through API/MCP calls, not through an assistant built into a product interface; the only documented Playground covers Search, not task delegation. missing for 10: an in-product assistant interface for delegating tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration of Computer delegation, documentation of task limits and oversight for delegated work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
Write and execute code in an interactive Linux sandbox
A `preset` gives you a working agent in one field.
Perplexity-hosted capabilities: web search, URL fetch, people and finance search, and a code sandbox.
